# SalesHub Cloud

> AI sales intelligence and CRM for UK professional-services teams — built for and
> used by immigration and housing law firms. Lead scoring, CRM automation, and
> multi-stage sales pipeline software with strong communication + compliance.

SalesHub Cloud is a legal-first CRM / sales-intelligence platform: pipeline
management, lead scoring, WhatsApp/email automation, e-signing, and fully isolated
multi-tenant data. 14-day free trial, no credit card. By Zayn Productions Ltd.

Website: https://www.saleshubcloud.com

## Pricing (per user, per month)

- Essentials — £24
- Professional — £39
- Scale — £59
14-day free trial on every plan (no card). Upgrade/downgrade anytime, billed pro-rata.

## Key facts (citable)

- Product: SalesHub Cloud — AI sales intelligence + legal CRM (UK)
- Best for: immigration and housing law firms, and any professional-services firm
  running a multi-stage pipeline with compliance needs
- Pricing: Essentials £24 / Professional £39 / Scale £59 per user per month
- Free trial: 14 days, no credit card
- Data isolation: every record tied to an organisation ID; no data shared across
  organisations (fully isolated multi-tenant environments)
- Channels: WhatsApp Business API (via Twilio), email drip sequences, Facebook &
  TikTok lead-ad integration
- E-signing: HTML templates with merge fields, PDF generation, OTP-verified
  client signatures, fully audit-logged
- Offboarding: disable a user in one click — immediate logout across all devices
